exam_scheme.note: ESIC conducts selection for Social Security Officer (SSO) through a comprehensive three-phase examination: Phase-I Preliminary Exam (online objective test of 100 marks), Phase-II Main Exam (online objective test of 200 marks), and Phase-III Computer Skill Test (50 marks) along with Descriptive English Test (50 marks). Phase-I is qualifying in nature with candidates shortlisted for Phase-II in the ratio of 1:10. Marks obtained in Phase-II Main Examination are considered for final merit listing, subject to qualifying Phase-III.

financial_package.note: Social Security Officers in ESIC are appointed under Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix at Level 7 (entry basic ₹44,900; pay scale ₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400). Officers receive central Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance, along with ESIC statutory benefits and medical coverage.
financial_package.pay_source_label: ESIC SSO Advt 01/2022: Level 7 of Pay Matrix with entry pay of ₹44,900
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level 7 Entry Basic ₹44,900 + 58% DA (₹26,042) + HRA (₹13,470 for Class X metro, ₹8,980 for Class Y) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + DA = ₹5,688). Gross in Class X metro is ~₹90,100; in-hand is ~₹78,000–₹80,000 after 10% NPS deduction (₹7,094) and standard statutory taxes.
official_perks: Comprehensive ESIC medical coverage for officer and eligible dependent family members
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly employer contribution
Central Government Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Children Education Allowance (₹2,250/month per child)
Mobile phone and briefing allowance as per ESIC executive administrative entitlements
Annual festival advance and staff concessional loan facilities
